migrated_scope: Only internal receive-attempt composition is ported: an already-created read-only byte transport feeds the actual FrameDecoder, server dispatcher and all eighteen ServiceStateCoordinator observer positions on one dedicated writer Thread. The inert constructor performs no I/O/callbacks; the first RunAsync owns cancellation and repeated calls share its terminal result. This is not a production transport or authenticated account session.

Fixed reader-owned buffers cross a bounded channel (default four 4096-byte chunks plus active reader/writer buffers and uint16 partial-frame storage); display publication coalesces to one pending commit. Exact immutable-snapshot-bound inputs use a finite injected clock and force ResourceHeld=true even when the caller supplies false. Lifecycle and observed game phase stay separate, with attempt identity and successful-commit revisions.

Decode/reduction/commit serialize with retirement. Failed packets publish no partial state/count; earlier valid commits survive a later malformed frame in the same read. The actual decoder is fed bytewise to preserve this behavior; throughput optimization remains deferred. EOF calls Finish, cancellation does not finish partial frames, and missing required Ark runtime evidence fails with a fixed code rather than manufacturing Absent evidence.

Retirement is synchronous; cancellation callbacks and transport disposal run outside the state lock. Completion waits for the actual reader, joined writer, observer callback, cancellation callbacks and transport cleanup. Late noncooperative reads are discarded; held participants keep completion pending. Cleanup failure reports CleanupFailed/ResourcesReleased=false with a fixed exception, and repeated disposal shares the cleanup outcome.

Focused verification: 283 unique tests passed, with every frame split/direct-coordinator snapshot comparison, actual-thread ownership, malformed/EOF/error paths, bounded pressure, coalescing, cleanup and cancellation/commit races. Three additional repetitions passed 25 selected tests each, adding 150 race iterations; repeats do not increase the unique test count. A separate synthetic Python receipt sequence was decoded/applied; existing domain source-vector parity remains separate. Independent final review approved the slice.
outstanding_scope: Full client/run_client behavior remains unported: production socket/dial/transport, verification/login handshake, credentials/authentication, outbound writes/commands, SessionLogic responses, scheduler/automatic operations, runtime/resource installation, account reconnection and complete state parity. AccountSession and Android lifecycle APIs are unchanged; no official-server/device/authenticated readiness or real-network throughput acceptance.

All resources remain held; parsed catalogs/metadata cannot release the gate, and observed authenticated reducer text is not authentication proof. Saved publications require owner/current-attempt validation. Commit callbacks are ordered but coalesced, not a lossless event log or terminal-status channel; already-admitted callbacks may finish after retirement but none outlive completion.

Bytewise framing throughput remains unoptimized. Python resource holds continue receiving receipts and are not mapped onto Android terminal ResourceHeld status. The later local combined adapter/receive Core receipt is separate from focused, remote/platform and live acceptance; IsCompleteState remains false.
